verdict.rationale: Zapier MCP documents a plain-language flow: the user describes what they need, and the AI client calls the right Zapier action across 9,000+ apps and confirms what it did. Zapier Copilot is also documented as helping users create agents, which gives a first-party natural-language path for building automations. missing for 10: evidence that Zaps themselves can be built or edited entirely via natural language, detail on Copilot's natural-language scope (only a single thin mention), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe what you need in plain language. Your AI calls the right Zapier action and confirms what it did.
Schedule a meeting with one prompt. Your AI finds time on everyone's calendar and books it.
Create specialized agents—with the help of Zapier Copilot—to connect to your business data and perform tasks across 9,000+ apps.
It lets your AI take real actions across 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions, such as sending messages, creating tasks, and updating records
